description: A speaker addresses activists in Trafalgar Square protesting in solidarity with Iranian women and workers in Iran. On Saturday 3 December 2022, several hundred protesters gathered at Trafalgar Square as part of a series of ongoing worldwide protests in solidarity with Iranian women and Iran's wider population struggling for personal, political and religious freedom and social justice against a rut
